text: CONDITIONS AND EXCEPTIONS
textPreview: CONDITIONS AND EXCEPTIONS

text:
Low OCR confidence
Route to manual evidence correction. Do not evaluate uncertain values as a pass.
textPreview: Low OCR confidence | Route to manual evidence correction. Do not evaluate uncertain values as a pass.

text:
Source unavailable or rate limited
Set Pending Re-verification. Retry under source policy.
textPreview: Source unavailable or rate limited | Set Pending Re-verification. Retry under source policy.

text:
Mandatory requirement failed
Show the rule, linked evidence and permitted officer action.
textPreview: Mandatory requirement failed | Show the rule, linked evidence and permitted officer action.

text:
Data conflict
Set Review Required. Preserve both sources and their timestamps.
textPreview: Data conflict | Set Review Required. Preserve both sources and their timestamps.

text: End-to-end workflow. Stage 1 to 4 describes user onboarding and submission. Stage 5 to 8 describes system processing and verification. Stage 9 to 11 describes the procurement officer review, decision and audit. Exception states prevent silent passes.

text: MODEL SAFETY BOUNDARY
textPreview: MODEL SAFETY BOUNDARY

text:
No direct source access
The model cannot call government APIs or use credentials.
textPreview: No direct source access | The model cannot call government APIs or use credentials.

text:
Prompt isolation
Document text remains quoted input; system policy stays outside the document.
textPreview: Prompt isolation | Document text remains quoted input; system policy stays outside the document.

text:
Data minimisation
Redact or use approved local inference before sending sensitive content to a model.
textPreview: Data minimisation | Redact or use approved local inference before sending sensitive content to a model.

text:
Reproducibility
Store model/version, prompt template, schema result and reviewer correction.
textPreview: Reproducibility | Store model/version, prompt template, schema result and reviewer correction.

text: AI architecture. The model processes approved, controlled data and returns only schema-constrained candidates. A deterministic validator and rule engine control compliance outcomes. The officer has final authority. The safety boundary addresses prompt injection, raw data leakage and unsafe automated action.
